suite.blob_scan: 3 sizes (0.10/0.22/0.38) x 7x7 interior positions, contiguous order

purpose: T37 re-runnable regression baseline for the shipped rule-layer composition advice: coverage, distribution, change rate, alignment closed-loop. Geometric synthetic frames, no model, no labelled truth.

metric_definitions.M3_change: repeat pairs must never change; blob-scan adjacent-edge change rate; mean style run length over the ordered suite
metric_definitions.M1_coverage: distinct first-choice styles; expressed excludes CONSERVATIVE/GENERIC, denominator 19
metric_definitions.M2_distribution: first-choice counts, entropy normalised by ln(21), top share
metric_definitions.M4_alignment: obedient re-framing walk: apply planner move to blob parameters fraction=0.6 per step, budget=16 steps, success = real AlignmentTracker emits ALIGNED; eligible = first advice carries an action

M4_alignment.walk: step_fraction=0.6, budget=16, pan/tilt shift the mass, dolly grows it, mass kept inside the frame

snapshot.note: verbatim snapshots; internal visibility resolves inside one Gradle module; the rest of CompositionPipelineContracts.kt is excluded (CompositionFrame sits with CameraX bindings)

limitations: flat geometric shapes on flat grounds are not photographs; no aesthetic judgement is measured
no model participates: the d1 gate, selection gate and scheduling are outside this harness
the re-framing walk assumes an obedient operator and exact parameter control; real camera moves overshoot
desktop JVM latency is not device latency
style coverage reflects this fixed suite only; missing styles may need other geometry or real scenes
